description: This file declares the HttpRequest class used for handling HTTP requests within the Rialto server manager component. It includes methods for retrieving request details such as method, command, post data, and parameters, as well as a reply method to send responses.

classes.name: HttpRequest
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP request, providing access to request details and a method to send responses.

methods.name: HttpRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpRequest object with a connection and request info.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request (e.g., GET, POST).

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command or endpoint being requested.

methods.name: getPostData
methods.description: Returns the POST data sent with the request.

methods.name: getParams
methods.description: Returns the list of parameters extracted from the request.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Sends a response message back to the client.
